title: Taskbase 2018 — homepage with live NLP demos
stack: Angular 5.2.6 + Bootstrap 4.1, @angular/cli 1.7.1, Express backend for the demos
build: docker node:8 + @angular/cli 1.7.1: npm install then "ng build --prod --extract-css=false --base-href ./". Same recipe as the April relaunch.
notes: Real AOT production build of the original Angular 5 source, not a reconstruction. Final state of the standalone repo before the monorepo import. The landing page is visually identical to the April relaunch — the grammar and content-matching demos live at unlinked /examples routes and were not yet on the homepage. Both demos render (English Exercise, Deutschaufgabe/Ansichtskarte); the Express backend under src/backend is not run, so "Antworten" produces no feedback. Contact form posts nowhere; Google Tag Manager stripped. Deep links (examples, examples/grammar, examples/matching, team, impressum, technology/0..5) work. The old specimen card is kept as specimen.html.
